1812: the capital moves from Turku to Helsinki.

notes: No Cliopatria row; the lands lie inside its Russian Empire shapes until the Republic of Finland (1918). Typed colony because it was an autonomous dependency of the Russian emperor as Grand Duke; the colour agent may prefer the Russian family tint. The pages give no area; the shape is Natural Earth Finland (which includes Aland and the lands east of the Tornio and Muonio) plus radii for Old Finland, a reading. Not on the pages: the dates of the Russian conquest (1808) beyond the February invasion, Petsamo (1920) and the 1920 Treaty of Tartu border, the Aland dispute after 1917. The 1940 and 1944 cessions after the dossier ends are in the Moscow Peace Treaty page (see russian-soviet-federative-socialist-republic). Gazetteer: the Sortavala-Ladoga radius uses coordinates.
